defectSummary.defect: Indicator-based v1.2 live attempt recognition in Gate 0 allowed un-laned requests (such as phase 5B legacy paths without executionLane) to bypass the dual-lane v1.2 live block despite CANARY_SPECIFICATION_VERSION being globally 'a12b2c5-v1.2'.
defectSummary.rootCause: Gate 0 check only evaluated indicators like phase === 'A.12B.2C-5D', executionLane, or approval targetPhase === 'A.12B.2C-5D' rather than authoritatively checking the global specification version.

remediation.gate0Refactoring: Implemented authoritative global specification version check in Gate 0: when CANARY_SPECIFICATION_VERSION === 'a12b2c5-v1.2', executeLiveCanary immediately fails closed with CANARY_KILL_SWITCH_TERMINATED and UNAUTHORIZED_ENVIRONMENT before inspecting credentials, approval envelope, or invoking any network.
remediation.transportPipelineIsolation: Refactored executeLiveCanary to delegate core network transport to an isolated executeTransportPipeline method, and exposed executeIsolatedMockTransport for hermetic test execution with an explicit customFetch requirement, ensuring executeLiveCanary has zero bypasses.

securityInvariants.gate0FailClosedOrder: Gate 0 evaluates before credential checks, approval envelope cryptographic checks, budget checks, or any network initiation

coveredScenarios: (C) Phase 5B + no lane fails closed pre-network (exact uncovered defect path)
(F) Cryptographically valid v1.2 approval token and envelope cannot bypass block
(G) Invalid, forged, or malformed approval envelope hits Gate 0 block first without altering fail-closed ordering
(H) Real-looking provider environment values are never inspected or required to reach block
